title: Luke Bible Quiz - Chapter 18
description: Ten questions on Luke 18: the widow and the judge, the Pharisee and the tax collector, the rich ruler and the blind man near Jericho.

questions.text: How is the judge in the parable described?
questions.explanation: The parable says there was a judge in a certain city who did not fear God and did not respect man.

answers.text: He was faithful and wise
He feared God but despised men
He did not fear God and did not respect man
He was a ruler of the synagogue

questions.text: Why did the judge finally decide to defend the widow?
questions.explanation: He said that because this widow bothered him, he would defend her, or else she would wear him out by her continual coming.

answers.text: Because she kept bothering him and would wear him out
Because he had begun to fear God at last
Because she paid him two denarii for help
Because the judge respected her husband

questions.text: What did the Pharisee in the temple say he did?
questions.explanation: The Pharisee prayed that he was not like other men, and said, "I fast twice a week. I give tithes of all that I get."

answers.text: He prayed day and night in the temple
He gave half of his goods to the poor
He had kept the commandments from his youth
He fasted twice a week and gave tithes of all he got

questions.text: What did the tax collector say as he beat his breast?
questions.explanation: Standing far away, he would not even lift up his eyes to heaven, but beat his breast and said, "God, be merciful to me, a sinner!"

answers.text: "God, I thank you that I am not like other men."
"God, be merciful to me, a sinner!"
"Lord, that I may see again."
"Increase our faith."

questions.text: What did Jesus say when the disciples rebuked those bringing babies to him?
questions.explanation: Jesus summoned them and said to allow the little children to come to him and not to hinder them, for God's Kingdom belongs to such as these.

answers.text: That the babies should be brought on another day
That only the disciples could touch them
That the little children should come to him and not be hindered
That the parents should first be taught

questions.text: What did Jesus tell the ruler he still lacked?
questions.explanation: Jesus said he still lacked one thing: to sell all that he had and distribute it to the poor, and then he would have treasure in heaven.

answers.text: To fast twice a week
To keep the commandments from his youth
To leave his house and family behind
To sell all he had and give it to the poor

questions.text: What comparison did Jesus make about a rich man entering God's Kingdom?
questions.explanation: He said it is easier for a camel to enter in through a needle's eye than for a rich man to enter into God's Kingdom.

answers.text: It is easier for a camel to go through a needle's eye
It is easier for a rich man than for a child
It is like a grain of mustard seed in a garden
It is like entering by a narrow door

questions.text: What did he answer when people asked, "Then who can be saved?"
questions.explanation: He said that the things which are impossible with men are possible with God.

answers.text: Only those who have left everything
What is impossible with men is possible with God
Those who fast and give tithes
No one who has riches

questions.text: What did the blind man near Jericho cry out?
questions.explanation: He cried out, "Jesus, you son of David, have mercy on me!" and cried out all the more when he was rebuked.

answers.text: "Jesus, Master, have mercy on us!"
"Lord, teach me to pray."
"What shall I do to inherit eternal life?"
"Jesus, you son of David, have mercy on me!"

questions.text: What did the blind man do after he received his sight?
questions.explanation: He immediately received his sight and followed him, glorifying God, and all the people who saw it praised God.

answers.text: He followed him, glorifying God
He went home to his own house
He told no one what had happened
He sold all that he had
